name: EventCardGrid - Three Uneven Cards
description: Three cards of deliberately uneven content — a long blurb, a short one, and none at all — every one in the same shape: a square image, the date, a title held to two lines, the place. The outer two carry real Luma covers; the middle one has none, so it shows the H mark on crimson in the same square. What the shared grid has to prove is that cards with and without covers, and with different amounts of text, still line their Learn more links up along the bottom. The middle card has no link, the state an event is in before its registration page exists, so it ends after the blurb rather than showing a dead one.
